clue.text: Stout assistance needed for such a comfortably-settled cat, nevertheless!

definitions.text: Stout assistance needed for such a comfortably-settled cat, nevertheless!

parts.words: Stout assistance needed for such a comfortably-settled cat, nevertheless!
